newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Railway Finance Corp raises $150 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Indian Railway Finance Corp raises $150 mln FRN.

text.p: The Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) has completed a $150 million seven-year floating rate note (FRN), arranger ANZ Investment Bank said on Monday.
IRFC is the sole fund raiser for the Indian Railways.
The issue was priced at LIBOR plus 75 basis points and the spread has been maintained when trading began in the secondary market, ANZ Investment Bank said in a statement.
"This is the second such international bond issue for the IRFC and follows the $70 million seven-year FRN arranged by ANZ Investment Bank last year," it said.
The Indian Ministry of Railways has undertaken to ensure that IRFC has funds available to service the bond at all times, it added.
